classificationPolicy.static: Preserve major petrified stump/root/rock structure and ambiguous pale spires; static is a presentation decision, not an assertion of canonical invulnerability for every pebble.
classificationPolicy.mutable: Candidate standalone visual object requiring a complete backing surface; does not grant harvesting, movement, destruction, or simulation behavior.
classificationPolicy.effect: Existing visible motion/atmosphere candidate; gameplay liquid/light/visibility rules remain unimplemented.

geometryPolicy.estimateTolerancePixels: Approximately 6–16 pixels for readable small groups; substantially greater at intertwined structural boundaries.
geometryPolicy.candidatePolygon: Rough hand-estimated search contour. It may include backing pixels and exclude fine twigs. NEVER use unchanged as a final alpha or exact collision mask.
geometryPolicy.overlap: Broad parent chunks intentionally overlap attached growth search regions. Resolve explicit front/back and keep each visible pixel owned once in the final reconstruction.
geometryPolicy.bounds: Some source regions touch image edges; clipped objects cannot become full standalone assets without separately marked reconstruction.
geometryPolicy.maskAcceptance: Trace/segment actual edges; retain thin stems and isolated caps; remove all checkerboard or backing contamination; inspect alpha and source-aligned recomposition.

gaps: Full left river-bank instance inventory, far-right cropped ecology and objects continuing below the frame are not complete. Edge ROIs are marked, not silently completed.
Backwall grain is continuous and roots interlock; chunk boundaries are compositing proposals, not inferred separable geological objects.

Foot anchors are visual estimates. Existing layout collision/occlusion geometry remains authoritative as a proposal until a reviewed final manifest replaces it.
